# Boston University
> Boston University’s official web presence for academics, admissions, research, student life, schools, libraries, and institutional resources.

Boston University is a private research university with extensive information for prospective students, current students, faculty, staff, researchers, alumni, and visitors. Its website spans admissions, degree programs, academic policies, schools and colleges, research administration, campus life, libraries, and university services.

## University Overview
- [Boston University Home](https://www.bu.edu/): Main university homepage with navigation to academics, admissions, research, campus life, and services.
- [About BU](https://www.bu.edu/about/): Institutional overview, history, leadership, facts, and information about the university.
- [Academics](https://www.bu.edu/academics/): Central academic hub for schools, colleges, degree programs, and academic policies.
- [Admissions](https://www.bu.edu/admissions/): Entry point for undergraduate admissions information, application guidance, and campus visit resources.
- [Research](https://www.bu.edu/research/): Overview of BU’s research enterprise, support offices, compliance, and funding resources.
- [Campus Life](https://www.bu.edu/campuslife/): Student life resources covering housing, dining, health, activities, and campus services.
- [Global BU](https://www.bu.edu/global/): International programs, global engagement, and study abroad opportunities across BU.

## Admissions & Enrollment
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.bu.edu/admissions/): Undergraduate application requirements, deadlines, financial aid, and visit information.
- [How to Apply](https://www.bu.edu/admissions/apply/): Application instructions, required materials, and process details for first-year and transfer applicants.
- [Tuition & Aid](https://www.bu.edu/admissions/tuition-aid/): Undergraduate tuition, fees, scholarships, and financial aid information.
- [Visit BU](https://www.bu.edu/admissions/visit-us/): Campus tours, virtual events, and visit planning resources for prospective students.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://www.bu.edu/grad/admissions/): Graduate admissions guidance, application steps, and school-specific requirements.
- [Graduate School of Arts & Sciences Admissions](https://www.bu.edu/grad/admissions/): Admissions information for many master’s and doctoral programs.
- [BU Virtual](https://www.bu.edu/online/): Online degree and certificate offerings for remote and working learners.

## Academics & Degree Programs
- [Academic Bulletin](https://www.bu.edu/academics/): Official academic bulletin with degree requirements, policies, and program descriptions.
- [Schools & Colleges](https://www.bu.edu/academics/schools-colleges/): Directory of BU’s schools and colleges with links to academic units.
- [Degree Programs](https://www.bu.edu/academics/degree-programs/): Searchable listing of undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs.
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://www.bu.edu/academics/degree-programs/?degree_level=undergraduate): Filtered degree program listings for undergraduate study.
- [Graduate Programs](https://www.bu.edu/academics/degree-programs/?degree_level=graduate): Filtered degree program listings for graduate and professional study.
- [Academic Policies](https://www.bu.edu/academics/policies/): University-wide academic rules, standards, and policy references.
- [BU Hub](https://www.bu.edu/hub/): General education framework and learning outcomes for undergraduate students.

## Schools & Colleges
- [College of Arts & Sciences](https://www.bu.edu/cas/): Programs, departments, research, and student resources in arts and sciences.
- [College of Engineering](https://www.bu.edu/eng/): Engineering academics, research, departments, and admissions information.
- [Questrom School of Business](https://www.bu.edu/questrom/): Business school programs, faculty, research, and student opportunities.
- [College of Communication](https://www.bu.edu/com/): Communication, journalism, film, and media studies programs and resources.
- [School of Public Health](https://www.bu.edu/sph/): Public health education, research, admissions, and community impact initiatives.
- [School of Medicine](https://www.bumc.bu.edu/busm/): Medical education, research, departments, and student information.
- [School of Law](https://www.bu.edu/law/): Law degree programs, admissions, clinics, and legal scholarship resources.
- [Wheelock College of Education & Human Development](https://www.bu.edu/wheelock/): Education and human development programs, research, and community partnerships.

## Research & Innovation
- [Research Home](https://www.bu.edu/research/): Central portal for research news, administration, compliance, and support services.
- [Office of Research](https://www.bu.edu/research/office-of-research/): Research leadership, policies, and administrative support for investigators.
- [Sponsored Programs](https://www.bu.edu/research/osp/): Proposal submission, award management, and sponsored research administration.
- [Research Compliance](https://www.bu.edu/research/compliance/): Compliance programs for human subjects, animals, biosafety, and responsible conduct.
- [Industry Engagement](https://www.bu.edu/research/industry-engagement/): Partnerships connecting BU research with industry collaborators and sponsors.
- [Technology Development](https://www.bu.edu/research/technology-development/): Commercialization, licensing, patents, and startup support for university innovations.
- [Centers & Institutes](https://www.bu.edu/research/centers-institutes/): Directory of interdisciplinary research centers and institutes across BU.

## Libraries & Scholarly Resources
- [BU Libraries](https://www.bu.edu/library/): Library services, collections, research help, and access to scholarly resources.
- [Search Library Resources](https://www.bu.edu/library/find/): Discovery tools for books, journals, databases, and other library materials.
- [Research Guides](https://www.bu.edu/library/help/research-guides/): Subject and course guides curated by librarians for research support.
- [Library Services](https://www.bu.edu/library/services/): Borrowing, reserves, digitization, consultations, and other library services.
- [Special Collections](https://www.bu.edu/library/about/special-collections/): Archives and distinctive collections supporting primary-source research.
- [OpenBU](https://open.bu.edu/): Institutional repository for BU scholarship, publications, and open-access materials.

## Student Life & Campus Services
- [Campus Life](https://www.bu.edu/campuslife/): Overview of student services, activities, wellness, and campus engagement.
- [Housing](https://www.bu.edu/housing/): On-campus housing options, assignments, rates, and residential life information.
- [Dining Services](https://www.bu.edu/dining/): Meal plans, dining locations, menus, and nutrition resources.
- [Student Health Services](https://www.bu.edu/shs/): Medical, behavioral health, prevention, and wellness services for students.
- [Dean of Students](https://www.bu.edu/dos/): Student support, conduct, crisis response, and community standards resources.
- [Student Activities Office](https://www.bu.edu/sao/): Student organizations, leadership programs, and campus events support.
- [Disability & Access Services](https://www.bu.edu/disability/): Accommodations and accessibility support for students with disabilities.
- [Career Development](https://www.bu.edu/careers/): Career advising, internships, job search tools, and employer engagement.

## Global Programs & Study Abroad
- [Global Programs](https://www.bu.edu/global/): University-wide global engagement, partnerships, and international opportunities.
- [Study Abroad](https://www.bu.edu/abroad/): Study abroad programs, advising, applications, and international academic experiences.
- [International Students & Scholars Office](https://www.bu.edu/isso/): Immigration, visa, and support services for international students and scholars.
- [Global House](https://www.bu.edu/globalprograms/global-house/): Residential and programming community focused on intercultural exchange.
- [Global Development Policy Center](https://www.bu.edu/gdp/): Research and policy analysis on global development and governance.

## Information for Current Students, Faculty & Staff
- [Student Link](https://www.bu.edu/studentlink/): Student portal for registration, records, billing, and academic services.
- [MyBU Student](https://www.bu.edu/mybu/): Student information system for academics, finances, and personalized university tasks.
- [Faculty & Staff](https://www.bu.edu/directory/faculty-staff/): Entry point to resources and directory information for employees.
- [BU Directory](https://www.bu.edu/directory/): Searchable directory for people, departments, and university contacts.
- [TechWeb](https://www.bu.edu/tech/): Information technology services, accounts, software, security, and support documentation.
- [Human Resources](https://www.bu.edu/hr/): Employment, benefits, payroll, policies, and workplace resources for staff and faculty.
- [Registrar](https://www.bu.edu/reg/): Registration, transcripts, calendars, and academic records services.

## News, Events & Athletics
- [BU Today](https://www.bu.edu/articles/): University news, feature stories, announcements, and campus reporting.
- [Events Calendar](https://www.bu.edu/calendar/): Central calendar for academic, cultural, and community events across BU.
- [Commencement](https://www.bu.edu/commencement/): Graduation ceremony information, schedules, and planning resources.
- [Athletics](https://goterriers.com/): Official Boston University athletics site with teams, schedules, and news.
- [Alumni & Friends](https://www.bu.edu/alumni/): Alumni engagement, events, giving, and lifelong connection resources.
- [Giving to BU](https://www.bu.edu/giving/): Philanthropy and donation information supporting schools, programs, and initiatives.
